subject: Confirmation: Opt-out of training on customer data (AcmeFin)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Johnson <claire.johnson@acmefin.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Confirmation: Opt-out of training on customer data (AcmeFin)

Hi Claire —

Thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and a couple of asks to make sure our legal/ops teams align before we spin up your trial Dedicated environment: 

Summary from call:
- Goal: evaluate Redwood for customer-facing chat summarization and insights across US customers.
- Primary concerns: PII handling, data residency (US-only), retention windows, and whether customer traffic can be excluded from model training/improvement.

Per our discussion, here’s what I captured as the requested controls: 
1) Training opt-out: AcmeFin requires that zero customer interaction data be used to train or improve Redwood models or shared with third-party model improvement processes. Redwood provides a training-opt-out flag at the account level that prevents customer data from being included in any model improvement pipelines.
2) Data residency: All logged data and storage must be in US regions only.
3) Retention: Default request is 90 days for conversational logs; audit logs (access events) can be retained up to 1 year if required.
4) Logging controls: Token-level logging is off by default for opt-out customers; we can provide structured request/response metadata for troubleshooting without persisting raw user text.

Attachments: I have attached a short opt-out declaration template (AcmeFin-training-opt-out.pdf) for signature. If you can confirm the three items above and sign the attached opt-out doc, we will: 
- Flag your account to opt out of model training
- Configure storage in our US region only
- Apply the retention policy (90d logs, 1y audit) unless you request changes

Next steps / owners: 
- Claire: confirm items above and return signed opt-out (by Mon 2026-03-23 if possible)
- Dev Patel (cc): once we receive signed opt-out, he will provision the account-level config and confirm the logging/retention settings with your security team
- Marissa: coordinate MSA addendum if legal needs one and kick off trial provisioning

If any of the bullets above are incorrect or you want alternate retention lengths, please let me know.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
(555) 555-1212

Attachment: AcmeFin-training-opt-out.pdf (PDF, 22 KB)

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear recap. Two quick confirmations from our side: 

1) Training opt-out: Confirmed. AcmeFin requires that none of our customer interaction data be included in Redwood model training or improvement pipelines. We will sign the opt-out doc and return it.
2) Data residency: Confirmed — US-only.
3) Retention: We request 90 days for conversational logs. For audit/access logs we are fine with up to 1 year.
4) Logging controls: We would like token-level logging disabled and that any troubleshooting traces be provided as redacted/hashed payloads. Please confirm Redwood can provide redacted session traces for debugging.

I attached the signed opt-out declaration (signed-opt-out.pdf). Security has also asked for your SOC 2 summary — can you send a redacted SOC 2 report or summary?
